data.long_meaning: From the Old High German 'grabo' meaning 'gravel'. This name is of German origin and is commonly used as a surname. It does not have any specific biblical or spiritual meaning. The name Gruber carries the meaning “German: Gravel, Mountainous” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gruber usually hope their child will grow to embody german: gravel, mountainous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
